scope: Read-only static review of the inactive dependency hardlink helper. No execution, host/provider/DB/browser calls, tests, or source edits.

blocking_finding.detail: The first `fresh_receipt_and_reserve` guard requires free bytes >= 3 GiB + 1 MiB before branching into plan or apply. Reported current free space is already below 3 GiB by 1,499,136 bytes, so neither plan nor apply can reach candidate enumeration. The repair therefore cannot restore the stated floor under the reported starting condition.
blocking_finding.required_resolution: Keep the post-apply 3 GiB floor and strict bounded scope, but make the apply admission depend on the exact selected hardlink plan and sufficient expected gain to cover the current deficit plus a safety margin. Keep plan read-only. Recheck free space after each apply batch and stop immediately if the conservative floor cannot be maintained.

reviewed_scope_if_precondition_fixed.eligible_sources: Only exact byte/metadata-identical dependency files from the named owner-owned inactive release whitelist.
reviewed_scope_if_precondition_fixed.exclusions: The target and every detected active release/process inode are excluded; no archives, customer data, active paths or package payload bytes are deleted. Five existing rollout locks, no-follow source checks, full process reference inventory, per-link rechecks and 64 MiB maximum gain are retained.
reviewed_scope_if_precondition_fixed.mutations: Adds hardlinks for identical dependency files into the one inactive target, records pre-mutation metadata privately, preserves all paths and bytes, and reports nlink/ctime/target-mtime changes.
